problem: User cannot login to the system
solution:
1. Clear browser cache and cookies
2. Reset password via /forgot-password
3. Check if account is locked in Active Directory
4. If still failing, check VPN connection and retry

problem: Application is slow or timing out
solution:
1. Check server CPU/memory usage in monitoring dashboard
2. Clear application cache: run cache_clear.sh
3. Restart the application server if load > 85%
4. Check database query performance logs

problem: User needs to export or download a report
solution:
1. Go to Reports > Export section
2. Select date range and format (CSV/Excel/PDF)
3. For large reports, use the scheduled export feature
4. Reports are emailed to your registered email within 10 minutes

problem: Request for new feature or enhancement
solution:
Feature requests are reviewed in our bi-weekly sprint planning.
1. Submit via JIRA with tag 'feature-request'
2. Product team will review and prioritize
3. Expected timeline: 2-6 weeks depending on complexity

1. Check spam/junk folder first
2. Verify email address in profile settings
3. Check notification preferences in Settings > Notifications
4. IT team to verify SMTP server status

problem: User needs access or permissions to a resource
solution:
1. Submit access request form at /access-request
2. Get manager approval (email to your manager)
3. IT Admin will provision access within 2 business days
4. For urgent access, call IT helpdesk: ext. 1234
